title: Query Active AGV Errors From the WCS Database
candidate_goal: Retrieve the current active AGV error records from the WCS database by running the documented SQL query and viewing the returned results.
summary: The source describes logging into the WCS primary server, opening the WCS database, creating a new query tab, pasting the provided SQL statement against SystemActiveErrorModel, executing it, and reviewing the active error results.
rough_steps: Log into the WCS primary server. [Image support needed: screen or page showing the WCS primary server login access or initial server entry point.]
Open the WCS database. [Image support needed: screen or page showing the WCS database access point or database selection area.]
Open a new query tab by clicking the indicated control. [Image support needed: UI control or button used to open a new query tab and where the new tab appears.]
Copy and paste the provided SQL query into the newly opened query tab. [Image support needed: query editor area where the SQL statement should be entered.]

Use the provided query text: SELECT TOP (1000) [Id], [EntityInserted], [EntityLastUpdate], [Name], [Area], [Error], [LastSeen], [SystemErrorDescription], [SystemErrorResolution] FROM [Helix2x_1Prod_Robotics].[dbo].[SystemActiveErrorModel].
Right click on the query and click execute. [Image support needed: query area and execute action location in the database interface.]
Review the results area where the active errors appear. [Image support needed: results panel or table where active AGV errors are shown after execution.]
Check the returned fields in the results, including Id, EntityInserted, EntityLastUpdate, Name, Area, Error, LastSeen, SystemErrorDescription, and SystemErrorResolution.
expected_result: A results area displays active AGV error records returned from the SystemActiveErrorModel table, including the listed identifier, timestamp, area, error, description, and resolution fields.
failure_or_escalation_notes: Escalate if access to the WCS primary server or WCS database is not available.
Escalate if the query cannot be executed or the results area does not display returned active errors.
The source does not provide corrective actions for the returned errors; use the output for investigation only.
